weaponImprint.name: Golden Melody
weaponImprint.trait: If the user has full HP at the end of the action, she gains a random buff, lasting for 1 turn.
weaponImprint.effect: Increase damage dealt by 10%/10%/15%/20%/20%/20%. When gaining buffs, increase damage dealt by the next [effect:ab2e634f-d257-44e3-af90-ce66a6ac43f3] by 10%/15%/15%/15%/20%/20% 1/1/1/1/1/2 time(s), stacking up to 2/2/3/3/4/4 times.
weaponImprint.imprintDescription: Increase damage dealt to ELIDs by 2.5%. If the target is not protected by Cover, increase it by an additional 2.5%.

data.effects: A Doll who steps up to shoulder heavy responsibilities. She dedicates her time and energy to Griffin, while perfectly maintaining her individuality, thanks to her precise and efficient work planning. She never deviates, never breaks the rules; rather than changing the plan, she prefers to change reality.

level1.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 8 tiles and deals Physical damage equal to 80% of attack to it.

Gains 1 point of Confectance Index each time after dealing damage. Increases damage dealt to targets not under the protection of Cover by 10%. When an enemy unit within range receives targeted damage from an ally, performs 1 instance of [effect:ab2e634f-d257-44e3-af90-ce66a6ac43f3], dealing Physical damage equal to 90% of attack and 2 points of stability damage. This effect can be triggered up to 3 times per turn.

level2.description: Gains 1 point of Confectance Index each time after dealing damage. Increases damage dealt to targets not under the protection of Cover by 10%. When an enemy unit within range receives targeted damage from an ally, performs 1 instance of [effect:ab2e634f-d257-44e3-af90-ce66a6ac43f3], dealing Physical damage equal to 90% of attack and 2 points of stability damage. This effect can be triggered up to 3 times per turn. After performing [effect:ab2e634f-d257-44e3-af90-ce66a6ac43f3], applies [effect:71b3f790-db3b-4188-a3d7-15fa9752b57a] to the target for 2 turns. Damage dealt by [effect:ab2e634f-d257-44e3-af90-ce66a6ac43f3] is increased by 10%.

vertebraeUpgrade.effect: After [effect:ab2e634f-d257-44e3-af90-ce66a6ac43f3], apply [effect:71b3f790-db3b-4188-a3d7-15fa9752b57a] to the target for 2 turns. [effect:ab2e634f-d257-44e3-af90-ce66a6ac43f3]'s damage increases by 10%.

level3.description: Gains 1 point of Confectance Index each time after dealing damage. Increases damage dealt to targets not under the protection of Cover by 20%. This effect can be triggered up to 3 times per turn. After performing [effect:ab2e634f-d257-44e3-af90-ce66a6ac43f3], applies [effect:71b3f790-db3b-4188-a3d7-15fa9752b57a] to the target for 2 turns. Damage dealt by [effect:ab2e634f-d257-44e3-af90-ce66a6ac43f3] is increased by 10%.

vertebraeUpgrade.effect: Increases damage by 10% against targets without Cover protection.

level1.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 8 tiles, deals Burn damage equal to 150% of attack to them and the user gains [effect:e1d78dfe-8609-4ee8-a770-ac155116bff3].

level2.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 8 tiles, dealing Burn damage equal to 150% of attack to them. Additionally, this unit gains [effect:e1d78dfe-8609-4ee8-a770-ac155116bff3] as well. If the enemy is killed from this skill, increases the damage bonus from [effect:e1d78dfe-8609-4ee8-a770-ac155116bff3] by 30%.

vertebraeUpgrade.effect: If a kill is scored, increase the damage bonus of [effect:e1d78dfe-8609-4ee8-a770-ac155116bff3] to 30%.

level1.description: Selects 1 direction and deals AoE Burn damage equal to 110% of attack to the first enemy target within 8 tiles in the selected direction. Applies [effect:71b3f790-db3b-4188-a3d7-15fa9752b57a] for 2 turns.

level2.description: Selects 1 direction and deals AoE Burn damage equal to 110% of attack to the first enemy target within 8 tiles in the selected direction. Applies [effect:71b3f790-db3b-4188-a3d7-15fa9752b57a] for 2 turns. If the target is already affected by [effect:71b3f790-db3b-4188-a3d7-15fa9752b57a], the critical rate of this attack is increased by 100%.

vertebraeUpgrade.effect: If the target is inflicted with [effect:71b3f790-db3b-4188-a3d7-15fa9752b57a], increases the critical rate of this attack by 100%.

level1.description: Gains 3 stacks of [effect:faecc72a-efdd-48e7-a947-60d52f647024]. At max Confectance Index, gains 1 additional stack and increases the maximum number of [effect:ab2e634f-d257-44e3-af90-ce66a6ac43f3] this turn by 1.

imagoforms.effect: Damage dealt by Support Attacks is increased by 5%.

dollEffects.effectDetails: Increase damage dealt with [effect:ab2e634f-d257-44e3-af90-ce66a6ac43f3] by 15%. Damage against exposed units is increased by 10%. Activates 1 time. This buff cannot be cleansed.
